title: A Visitor for the Winter
author: Beatrix Pemberton
blurb: Theo Joubert, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
